name: Petra (Wadi Musa basin, Ma'an Governorate, Jordan)
terrain_title:
Petra: GLO-30 terrain (50 m contours), city limits (yellow), desert outside (sand); the wadis are dry;
real ways: tracks along Wadi Musa and the Colonnaded Street (red), trails and rock-cut steps (white)
note: Terrain benchmark site (user request 2026-11-25). Jordan is not a training, validation, development or declared held-out region of any milestone (configs/m17_holdout.json, configs/m15_benchmark/manifest.json).
centre_note: the midpoint of the Treasury (Al-Khazneh) and the Monastery (Ad Deir), so that the 2048 m domain holds the end of the Siq, the Royal Tombs, the Colonnaded Street basin, Qasr al-Bint and the Ad Deir plateau
dry_wadis_note: Petra has no permanent surface water (arid, ephemeral wadis). OSM maps the wadis as waterway=stream (Wadi Musa, Wadi Turkmaniyya); they are treated as dry ground, so the water layer is empty and no street needs a bridge. Declared before any generation.

city_limits.note: geometry only: an ellipse centred on the ancient city centre (30.3286 N, 35.4419 E -> (1037, 841) m), its long axis along Wadi Musa (160 deg), with the same semi-axes and edge noise as Machu Picchu; it holds the Colonnaded Street basin and the sandstone massifs on both sides. NOT selected on slope, so that where each generator builds is part of the test
